blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY — The delivery of medical care in Lanao del Norte received a boost following the turnover on Friday of the province’s first computed tomography (CT) scanner at Kapatagan Provincial Hospital in Kapatagan, Lanao del Norte. The new diagnostic equipment aims to bring advanced health care services closer to residents who previously had to travel to neighboring cities or provinces for specialized medical imaging. Lanao del Norte Gov. Mohamad Khalid Dimaporo led the turnover ceremony, highlighting the provincial government’s efforts to modernize public health infrastructure and improve diagnostic accuracy for local doctors.
